_readme: Boating / motor restrictions per water, from the NMDGF Fishing Rules & Info booklet ('Regulations for Specific Waters' and the 'Boating Regulations' summary lists). Hand-maintained; refresh each April when the new booklet lands.
Keys match water names in stocking_data_clean.json.
rule   - none | non_motorized | electric_only | no_wake | unrestricted  (drives the short label)
text   - the rule as the booklet states it, plus any condition (season, lake level, permit).
source - booklet edition and page, or the agency page if not from the booklet.

Alto Lake.text: Boats without motors only; village boating permit required; boat hours sunrise to sundown.

Bear Canyon Reservoir.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Bill Evans Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Bonito Lake.text: No boats or floating devices allowed.

Charette Lake Lower.text: Boats restricted to trolling speeds; boats may be used only during the fishing season (noon March 1 to noon Oct 31).

Clayton Lake.text: Boats restricted to trolling speeds; boats may be used only during the fishing season (noon March 1 to noon Oct 31).

Conoco Pond.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Eagle Rock Lake.text: No boating, wading or swimming (protects the lake liner).
Eagle Rock Lake.source: Carson National Forest, Eagle Rock Lake Day Use Area page

Fenton Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Green Meadow Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Grindstone Reservoir.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only, trolling speeds; village boat permit required; boat hours sunrise to sundown; stay out of fenced or buoyed areas near the intake.

Heron Reservoir.text: No-wake lake: boats restricted to trolling speeds everywhere on the lake.

Hopewell Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Jackson Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Laguna Del Campo (Burns Lake).text: No boats or flotation devices allowed.

Lake Alice (Sugarite Canyon).text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only; daylight hours only.

Lake Farmington.text: Non-motorized watercraft only April 11 to Oct 25; open sunrise to sunset.

Lake Maloya.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only; daylight hours only.

Lake Roberts.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Maxwell Lake 13.text: Boats restricted to trolling speed; open noon March 1 to Oct 31.

Monastery Lake.text: No boats or floating devices allowed.

Morphy Reservoir.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors; open March 1 to Oct 31, weather permitting.

Navajo Reservoir.text: Motors allowed; designated no-wake areas are posted (and closed to kokanee snagging).

Oasis Park Lake.text: Boats and flotation devices are not allowed.

Quemado Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Shuree Ponds.text: Boats without motors only; open July 1 to Dec 31, daylight hours.

Snow Lake.text: Boats restricted to oars or electric motors only.

Springer Lake.text: Motorboats only when the lake holds 2,000 acre-feet or more; trolling speeds only when below that. No ice fishing.

Trees Lake.text: No boats allowed; open sunrise to sunset.
